blogs.title: Why LSTMs Are Making a Comeback: From 1990s Roots to Billion‑Parameter Models
blogs.description: A high‑level tour of LSTMs’ legacy in AI, why transformers eclipsed them, and how the new xLSTM paper revives recurrent networks by scaling them to billions of parameters with modern tricks.

blogs.title: Exponential Gating Explained: Letting Recurrent Networks Rewrite Their Past
blogs.description: An accessible deep‑dive into exponential gating—how it lets an LSTM revise earlier storage decisions, the role of normalization and stabilization, and why this simple change dramatically improves memory handling.

blogs.title: sLSTM vs mLSTM: Two New Flavors of Memory for Recurrent Networks
blogs.description: Compare the scalar‑memory sLSTM that introduces memory mixing across cells with the matrix‑memory mLSTM that stores key–value pairs via a covariance update rule, highlighting their capacity vs parallelism trade‑offs.

blogs.title: From Cells to Blocks: Building xLSTM Architectures with Residual Stacking
blogs.description: Explain how sLSTM and mLSTM cells are wrapped in modern residual block backbones (post up‑projection for sLSTM, pre up‑projection for mLSTM) to form xLSTM blocks that can be stacked like transformer layers.

blogs.title: Scaling Recurrent Models: xLSTM’s Performance on Language Modeling Benchmarks
blogs.description: Summarise experimental results showing xLSTM models trained on 15 B–300 B tokens beating Transformers, State‑Space Models and other RNNs on perplexity, Long‑Range Arena tasks, PALOMA domain benchmarks, and scaling law curves.

blogs.title: Speed vs Memory Trade‑offs in xLSTM: Parallelism, GPU Kernels, and Real‑World Inference
blogs.description: Discuss practical considerations such as linear time/constant memory complexity versus quadratic attention cost in transformers; cover GPU optimisations for sLSTM/mLSTM and compare inference throughput against Llama and Mamba.
